title: React Revision Notes
content:
# React Revision Notes

A practical refresher for **React**, hooks, routing and state management.

## Hooks

- `useState` for local state
- `useEffect` for synchronization
- `useMemo` for expensive derived values

> Build small components and keep state close to where it is used.
